No Android source or original gameplay execution claim. Native landing craft uses the fixed PC 20x32 body/dead/shadow without rotation; native dimensions and loaded drawables follow e.i. Native air transport uses the fixed PC 45x47 body/dead/shadow without rotation; native dimensions and loaded drawables follow e.i. Qualified PC AA custom body/dead/turret and shared three-image beam retain native sizes and north orientation; AUTO shadow preserves body alpha with RGB black. No original gameplay execution claim. Qualified accelerated AA reuses its native seven images plus shared 32x32 glow_sharp movement trails; no original effect code execution or random decoration parity claim.
